newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says plans drastic cost cuts.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says plans drastic cost cuts.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company LM AB Ericsson said on Wednesday that all its production plants planned drastic cost cuts to counteract price pressures in the telecommunications market.
"We know as everybody else in this industry that the price drop will continue," Ericsson's chief executive Lars Ramqvist told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
"Countermeasurements we have taken, and we have succeeded now during a number of years to cut costs in production.
"All of our production plants are really planning for a drastic reduction of costs.
"This is turning into a mass market and consumer electronic business and you must be ready for price pressure."
